def _covering_set_of_owners_for(self, files):
  owner_combinations = []
  every_owner = set()
  for f in files:
    dirname = self.os_path.dirname(f)
    current_owners = set()
    while dirname in self.owners_for:
      current_owners |= self.owners_for[dirname]
      every_owner |= current_owners
      if self._stop_looking(dirname):
        break
      dirname = self.os_path.dirname(dirname)
    owner_combinations.append(current_owners)
  return owner_combinations
